-- 48x48 image, displayed at 192x192 pixels.
-- Change pixelSize to resize it: 2=96px, 3=144px, 4=192px, 6=288px, 8=384px.
-- RLE format: 2 hex digits run length + 2 hex digits palette index.

render.clear()

local startX, startY = 100, 80
local pixelSize = 4
local width, height = 48, 48

local palette = {
    {255, 255, 255},
    {254, 254, 254},
    {252, 252, 251},
    {253, 253, 252},
    {207, 207, 208},
    {247, 246, 241},
    {255, 254, 254},
    {237, 234, 219},
    {101, 75, 68},
    {168, 164, 163},

    {90, 58, 46},
    {77, 55, 50},
    {71, 45, 39},
    {49, 31, 30},
    {61, 43, 40},
    {102, 91, 95},
    {97, 65, 53},
    {196, 181, 156},
    {122, 81, 64},
    {117, 76, 60},
    {114, 106, 101},
    {255, 255, 254},
    {246, 207, 179},
    {251, 203, 77},
    {143, 121, 96},
    {132, 102, 77},
    {154, 135, 96},
    {201, 163, 97},
    {192, 151, 76},
    {246, 193, 110},
    {232, 183, 97}
}

    "011501030101150002010105011B011C0209010A010C010A01170618011D0418011D011501100104010001030D00"
})

local pixel = 0

for i = 1, #data, 4 do
    local count = tonumber(string.sub(data, i, i + 1), 16)
    local colourIndex = tonumber(string.sub(data, i + 2, i + 3), 16)
    local c = palette[colourIndex + 1]

    if count and c then
        local remaining = count
        while remaining > 0 and pixel < width * height do
            local x = pixel % width
            local y = math.floor(pixel / width)
            local run = math.min(remaining, width - x)

            render.rect_filled(
                startX + x * pixelSize,
                startY + y * pixelSize,
                run * pixelSize,
                pixelSize,
                color(c[1], c[2], c[3])
            )

            pixel = pixel + run
            remaining = remaining - run
        end
    end
end

print("Rendered pixels:", pixel, "/", width * height)
print("RLE draw calls:", 1103)
